summary: A pseudo-class starts with a colon and matches elements in a certain state (:hover, :focus-visible, :active) or position (:first-child, :nth-child()).
notes: a:hover changes link color while the mouse is over it. Hover over Slides or Starter code in the preview.
Press Tab in the preview: :focus-visible draws an orange outline on the focused link, input, or button.
li:nth-child(odd) shades every other row, which makes long lists easier to scan.
pitfall: Removing outlines with outline: none and nothing in its place. Keyboard users can no longer see where they are on the page.
